dse_runs.notes: High-throughput spec: needs >=250 MSPS, so iterative family (13.2 MSPS at dw=16/n_iter=12) is far too slow; unrolled_k and pipelined have never reached a front on this device. Focus budget on pipelined_m (won bursty spec at dw=15, n_iter=14, m=7, 59.6 MSPS) with larger m for throughput, and a small check of unrolled_k for area. Selection rule is min LUTs subject to throughput>=250 and accuracy>=13 bits.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **dds_250msps** (NCO/DDS sin-cos generator, ≥250 MSPS, max error ≤ 2⁻¹³, minimize LUTs) was taken down the full ladder: L1 used all 400 evaluations via the structured DSE graph (3 refinement rounds), producing a 26-design feasible Pareto front; L2 DDS simulation of the top design confirmed SFDR 100.5 dBc and SNR 88.3 dB with no selection change; L3/L4 had no recorded rows for this design class, so back_annotate returned no_measured_data with no winner change flagged, and reexplore was not needed. Finalized selection: **pipelined, data_width=19, n_iter=15, no guards, round — 935 LUTs (est), 969 FFs, 13.2 accuracy bits, 264 MSPS, max error 2⁻¹³·¹⁸**. Notably, the plain pipelined family reached the front and won here, unlike prior campaigns where it never did; pipelined_m and unrolled_k could not beat it on LUTs at this throughput. The lesson was stored to memory.
